clusterService.description: an in-cluster HTTPS service to call instead of GUS, NBP, gov.pl and dane.gov.pl, at the gusBaseUrl, nbpBaseUrl, govPlBaseUrl and daneGovPlBaseUrl paths, its certificate issued for their hosts

gusBaseUrl.description: The GUS SDP API, or a mirror of it: an https URL; the install shows its host and the grant approves it

nbpBaseUrl.description: The NBP archive, or a mirror of it: an https URL; the install shows its host and the grant approves it

govPlBaseUrl.description: gov.pl, whose Ministry of Finance page links the retail bond spreadsheet, or a mirror of it: an https URL; the install shows its host and the grant approves it

daneGovPlBaseUrl.description: The dane.gov.pl API, which lists the same spreadsheet, or a mirror of it: an https URL; the install shows its host and the grant approves it
